description: This source file defines the PdfGenericField class, representing a generic form field in PDF documents within the PDFsharp library. It extends PdfAcroField to handle fields that are not specifically known or defined in the library, providing constructors and a nested Keys class for dictionary keys.

classes.name: PdfGenericField
classes.description: Represents a generic, possibly unknown, AcroForm field in PDF documents, used when the field type isn't explicitly defined in PDFsharp.

classes.name: PdfGenericField.Keys
classes.description: Nested class defining the dictionary keys for PdfGenericField, inheriting from PdfAcroField.Keys.

methods.name: PdfGenericField(PdfDocument document)
methods.description: Constructor initializing the generic field with a PDF document.

methods.name: PdfGenericField(PdfDictionary dict)
methods.description: Constructor initializing the generic field from a PDF dictionary object.
